reviews.rationale: The May 19, 2025 signing of the TAKE IT DOWN Act meets the contract's early-resolution rule: a completed substantive action protecting individuals against AI-generated abuse. It contradicts the categorical no-protection component regardless of the administration's broader policy priorities.
